item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from preferences import Preferences
from repository import Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead, MissingPreference

for raw_key, outcomes, expected_calls in [
    ('w', [{'color': 'blue'}], 1),
    ('\\t w \\n', [{'color': 'blue'}], 1),
    (' w ', [TransientRead('one'), TransientRead('two'), {'color': 'blue'}], 3),
]:
    backend = ScriptedBackend(outcomes)
    assert Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(raw_key) == {'color': 'blue'}
    assert backend.keys == ['w'] * expected_calls

permanent = MissingPreference('missing')
backend = ScriptedBackend([TransientRead('busy'), permanent, {'color': 'blue'}])
try:
    Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(' w ')
except MissingPreference as error:
    assert error is permanent
else:
    raise AssertionError('Permanent error did not propagate')
assert backend.keys == ['w', 'w']
print('4 supplemental contract checks passed')
PY"
